Subject: Sync request — portal ownership mapping and CAIQ snapshot

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for taking this on. We're preparing to onboard more of our integrations into OneTrust/Whistic (we use both for different buyers) and noticed the profile currently lists our former platform lead as the owner. That person left last quarter — we'd like to swap ownership to our security engineer and also pre-stage CAIQ/SIG evidence so your portal ingestion job has less manual triage.

Quick context:
- Profile ID: WH-74219 (Whistic) / OT-tenant 9345
- We have a recent CAIQ snapshot attached and an evidence manifest (see attachments).
- Goal: switch profile owner to "security-ops@clearvalley.com" and pre-stage the usual artifacts so Redwood's portal sync can pick up TTL and proof-of-possession fields automatically.

Asks:
1) Can you confirm the exact file names and minimal metadata tags your ingestion expects (we tried following documentation but want to confirm the ownership field mapping)?
2) Any constraints around TTL/retention that you need (SOC 2 audit window is Feb — we'd like to avoid re-uploads)?
3) If you prefer, we can add a temporary service account or SAML metadata for pre-staging — which is easier for you?

I've attached: CAIQ_snapshot_20261101.csv and evidence_manifest_20261101.xlsx.

Happy to jump on a short call; otherwise we'll await your mapping template and next steps.

Best,
Alicia Moore

ClearValley Inc.

From: sean.gallagher@redwood.com
To: Alicia Moore <alicia@clearvalley.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-02T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sync request — portal ownership mapping and CAIQ snapshot

Hi Alicia — thanks for the context and the attachments.

TL;DR: we can do a scoped owner swap + prestage ingest if you supply either the lightweight ownership matrix (one-row CSV) or a temporary SAML metadata file. I attached a one-row template that shows the exact headers we require.

Details / plan:
- Ownership mapping: we use a three-field mapping: profile_id, owner_email, owner_role. If you send that CSV populated (ownership_matrix-template.csv attached) we will:
  * update the portal owner in the next sync window (usually within 4 hours)
  * create an audit note on the profile with a timestamp and our operator id
- Evidence pre-staging: we accept CAIQ CSV snapshots and a manifest JSON — minimal metadata we require: artifact_name, artifact_type, upload_timestamp, proof_type (SOC2, KMS, Syslog), retention_until.
- TTL/retention: for SOC2 evidence we recommend retention_until >= 2027-03-01 (covers your Feb audit). If your manifest includes that field we will preserve it; otherwise we'll default to 1 year from upload.
- Access options: Service account (API key) vs SAML pre-stage — Ben prefers SAML for ephemeral privileges, Laura prefers a short-lived service account if you cannot rotate SAML quickly.

Next steps I propose:
1) Alicia — reply with which method you prefer (populated CSV or SAML).
2) If CSV, attach populated ownership_matrix-template.csv. If SAML, send the metadata XML and allow redwood-portal@redwood.com to ingest.
3) We'll schedule a 30-min "litmus" sync to walk through the first ingest and confirm artifact mapping (suggested window: Wed 11/03 09:00-09:30 PT or 11/04 14:00-14:30 PT).

Looping in Laura (security ops) and Ben (portal infra) to confirm internal runbook and who will execute the ingest.

Cheers,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

From: laura.bennett@redwood.com

Thanks, Sean. A couple of security notes before we flip ownership:

Minimum evidence we require for the owner swap to be accepted without manual follow-up:
- Proof of authorization: either an org-level email from an authorized admin (e.g., security-ops@clearvalley.com) or a signed PDF on company letterhead referencing the profile ID.
- KMS attestation: if the profile lists encrypted-at-rest or custom KMS, please include the KMS key identifier and rotation cadence in the manifest.
- Syslog/retention: include the log retention policy (syslog retention_days) so we can map to our evidence TTL fields.

Process constraints:
- We cannot accept ownership changes solely from a personal mailbox (we need a role-based address or an exec signoff).
- If you want a faster path, provide the SAML metadata + a short admin note to security-ops@clearvalley.com (we'll accept that as authorization).

Scheduling: Wed 11/03 09:00 PT works for our team — please share a calendar invite. Agenda: 1) confirm owner mapping, 2) test a single CAIQ row ingest, 3) validate retention mapping.

I'll prepare a short checklist and post-call runbook for the ingest.

Laura Bennett
Senior Manager, Security Ops
Redwood Inference
